Strategy: Reward residuals between twenty-five and forty while penalizing residuals between five and twenty more strongly, building on a combination that already beat Best Fit. This pushes harder away from small awkward gaps, but the stronger penalty may hurt genuinely tight fits that would otherwise work.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 25 and r - item <= 40 else 0) - (30 if r - item >= 5 and r - item <= 20 else 0) for r in bins]
```
